description: This file defines the implementation of the MediaKeysTestBase class, which provides setup, teardown, and utility functions for testing media key management components in a media server environment. It includes mock object creation, media key session management, and thread task handling.

classes.name: MediaKeysTestBase
classes.description: A base class for media key management testing, providing methods to create and destroy media keys, create key sessions, and handle main thread tasks.

methods.name: MediaKeysTestBase::MediaKeysTestBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing mock objects for media key testing.

methods.name: MediaKeysTestBase::createMediaKeys
methods.description: Creates media keys with a specified key system, setting up necessary mocks and thread handling.

methods.name: MediaKeysTestBase::destroyMediaKeys
methods.description: Destroys the media keys, unregistering the client and cleaning up.

methods.name: MediaKeysTestBase::createKeySession
methods.description: Creates a media key session for a given key system, mocking session creation and verifying success.

methods.name: MediaKeysTestBase::mainThreadWillEnqueueTaskAndWait
methods.description: Sets up an expectation that a task will be enqueued on the main thread and executed immediately.
